invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null list, as it is a direct result of collecting a filtered stream into a list.
The input parameter 'hoodieRecords' is expected to be non-null, as it is directly used and passed to other methods.
The return type is always a List.
The filter ensures all elements in 'result' have unknown current locations.
Result is a filtered version of the input list, so its size cannot exceed the input size.
